test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: H, I, J, K, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between L and M. M is the immediate neighbour of I and J. H sits to the immediate right of I. How many people sit between K and H when counted from the left of K?
solution:
**Given: **H, I, J, K, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

1) H sits to the immediate right of I.

2) M is the immediate neighbour of I and J. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c6179d38a5ca8dbb09b7f628637140b55118b2bc6ba3cf0b35f97a0bd490c42.png] 

Only two people sit between L and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d105b8346fb594cd53db755a35a4cd3305e9e20a4a9fcbfe4c3da1bc84910e11.png] 

Final arrangement,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8f7da7a067aa3cab0b6f9a802de3f4d40ee22673781487fdcd38f72cf16776b.png] 

Thus, Only one people sit between K and H when counted from the left of K.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
